viator_experiences.description_md: The Birmingham Slogging Gangs Walking and Food Tour is a three-hour guided walk through the city, themed around the Peaky Blinders and the real gangs of Victorian Birmingham. Led in English by a costumed guide, it blends local history and culture with food and drink tastings along the way. The tour begins outside The Rainbow pub in Bordesley, where guests look for a gang member in a flat cap and cravat, and finishes at Turtle Bay in the city centre. Dinner, alcoholic beverages and all drinks are included, and the group is limited to a maximum of 14 travellers.
